༄༅/ /yang zlog me'i spu gri'i dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon gyi nyer mkho lhan thabs kyi rim pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yang zlog me'i spu gri'i dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon gyi nyer mkho lhan thabs kyi rim pa bzhugs so//

mū la gu ru mañju shrī ya mān+ta kā ya na mo nā ma/ 'dir yang zlog me'i spu gri'i sgo nas rab gnas dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon sogs nye bar mkho ba'i lhan thabs sngon 'gro'i rim pa 'di ni/ lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid la gsol ba btab pas legs par gnang ba'i mtshan ma mthong bas bri bar bgyi'o// dbang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa'i sngags pas dkyil 'khor gyi las bya ba la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la gnyis/ sa chog dang sta gon no// dang po sa'i cho ga ni drug ste/ sa brtag pa/ bslang ba/ sbyang ba/ gzung ba/ bsrung ba/ gnas gang du cho ga 'di rnams dgos mi dgos bshad pa'o// dang po sa brtag pa ni/ ji skad du/ mdor na sa gzhi mnyam pa dang*// mdangs snum shar du gzhol bar bzhed/ */ chu mang ldan pa'i gnas dang ni// ljon shing bzang pos brgyan pa dang*// bdag gi mig yid mgu ba dang*// 'tshe med zug rngu spangs pa ni// dkyil 'khor gnas su shis pa ste| |mi yis dngos grub kun thob byed// ces gsungs pas de 'dra bar bri zhing*/ de las ldog pa'i sa bkra mi shis pa rnams dang grong khyer sogs spang ngo*// de nas gtso bor las gang sgrub dang rjes su mthun pa'i sa brtag pa ni shin tu gal che'o// gnyis pa sa bslang ba ni/ snang ba la bslang ba dang*/ mi snang ba la bslang ba gnyis las/ dang po snang ba la bslang ba ni/ yul de'i rgyal po la sogs pa de'i bdag po la bslang ngam/ rin bcal nas gnang ba thob par bya'o// gnyis pa mi snang ba la bslang ba gnyis/ sa lha la bslang ba dang*/ bye brag gzhi bdag la bslang ba'o// gzhi de maṇ+ḍal byas par ba byung dang dri bzang byugs pa'i dbus su tshom bu gcig bkod/ de'i mdun du mchod pa dang dkar gtor gcig bshams/ skyabs sems/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs skyabs sems dang*/ ma rig rgyu sogs snying rje rnam gsum gsal btab/

mchan/ sngon du 'gro bas/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur gsal bar gyur par bsams la/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal dbus kyi tshom bu+u skad cig gis baṃ las byung ba'i sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo rab tu dga' ba'i thugs can zhi ba/ na bza' dkar po mnabs shing rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ zhal gcig /phyag gnyis/ g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang g.yon gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa pad zla'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bskyed/ rang gi lag pa g.yas pa zla bar hūm̐ gsum gsal ba'i 'od zer dang*/ mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan gzhan rnams bsgrengs pa sa la lan gsum bsnun cing*/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis bskul bas sa 'og nas sa yi lha mo ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo thon pa mdun gyi dam tshig pa la thim/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ gtor ma/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭ kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs spyi 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro mu khaṃ btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul nas/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon sa yi ni// lha mo chen mo 'jig rten yum// rin chen kun gyis rab gang ma| |bzang po'i rgyan gyis rnam brgyan ma// do shal rkang gdub sgra ldan ma// rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma// mchod yon 'di ni bzhes nas su// dkyil 'khor las ni rab grub mdzod// hi hi hi hi haṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gsol bas/ rigs kyi bu de ltar ci dga' bar byos shig /ces gnang ba byin nas steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur par bsam/ tshom bu gtor mchod rnams bsdu'o| |gnyis pa bye brag sa bdag dang zhing skyong la bslang ba ni/

gtor ma gnyis sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis zhing skyong sa gzhi'i bdag po skad cig gis mdun du bkug /oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro mu khaṃ btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// sa 'di bdag gis bslang bar bgyi// dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsol// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas gnang bar byin par bsam mo// zhing skyong dang sa bdag dkar phyogs pa rang gnas su gshegs/ nag phyogs pa ting nge 'dzin dang sngags kyis bskrad do/ hūm̐ nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed sogs/ mchan| gsum pa sa sbyang ba la gsum/ las dang bya bas nyes skyon sbyang ba/ drag sngags ting nge 'dzin gyis bgegs sbyang ba/ de bzhin nyid kyis thams cad sbyang ba'o// dang po las dang bya bas nyes skyon sbyang ba ni/ gzhi der lto 'phye'i thig btab la de'i dmigs nas sa brkos la legs nyes brtags shing sa'i skyon rdo shing sol rus srog chags sogs skyon thams cad bsal nas yid du 'ong bar bya'o// gnyis pa rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gyis bgegs sbyang ba ni/ las gshin gyi sngags bzlas pa'i chu dang yungs kar dang thal chen gyis dbang ldan nas brtsams te sa la khyab par gtor zhing*/ ba'i rnam lnga la las gshin gyi sngags bzlas pas khyab par byugs shing sbol nas ji ltar 'os pa'i stegs bu las dang rjes su mthun pa'i dbyibs can sra zhing mkhregs pa/ dbus cung zad mtho zhing byang shar yid tsam gzhol ba me long gi ngos ltar 'jam zhing legs par bya'o// de nas lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas sa gnon gyis stegs bu+u la reg cing*/

oṃ bhū khaṃ sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gyur/ hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ me dī ni badz+rī bha wa badz+ra bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sho dhā ya sho dhā ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams gsum gsum brjod cing lag gnyis kas reg la byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i sa'i lha mor mchod pa dang gtor ma sngar ltar phul la/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī bhū mi tiṣ+ṭha s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod pas gzhi de nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ yi ge gsum dang yi ge brgya pa brjod cing pad kor bya'o// gsum pa de bzhin nyid kyis thams cad sbyang ba ni/ chos dang chos can thams cad chos dbyings mnyam pa chen po'i ngang du rnam par dag par bya ba nyid do// bzhi pa sa gzung ba ni/ slob dpon stegs bu'i khar bsdad la/ skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang ma rig rgyu sogs/ rdor dril 'dzin dkrol/ cha gsum/ mchod pa dang sman raka gtor gsum byin rlabs/ tshogs zhing rnams dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon ltar byas rjes/ mchan/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nas/ mthu rtsal dang ldan par gyur gyi bar bya/ bzlas pa cung zad byas rjes/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs par bsam/ mchod cing bstod nas/ pus mo g.yas btsugs lag g.yas spos dang g.yon dril bu dkrol bar/ rang gi lce hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur par mos la/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs// bdag ni che ge rdo rje yis// 'dir ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyi// sangs rgyas la sogs kun spyon 'tshal// zhes lan gsum gsol/ mdun gyi lha rnams rang gi snying gar thim par gyur par bsam/

langs te phyogs kun du bgrad pa'i mig gis blta zhing*/ sems can ma rig pa'i mun par song zhing bdud kyis byin brlabs pa rnams kyi bdud bsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ rang nyid khro rgyal phyag rgya zil gnon bskal me ltar 'bar zhing 'bar ba hūm̐ sgra sgrog cing*/ mig g.yas ma las nyi ma dang*/ g.yon ṭa las zla ba mig 'bras hūm̐ las dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar bar gyur par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje can nga sems dpa' nga*// sangs rgyas rgyal po stobs chen nga*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdag po nga*// phyag rdor brtan pa khro rgyal nga*// byin gyis brlabs pa mi 'dor ro// zhes bsgrags/ rang gi rkang mthil gnyis su hūm̐ las rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa re re gsal bar gyur par bsam zhing*/ phyogs kun tu 'gying bas 'gro zhing rdo rje gsor/ dril bu dkrol/ pad kor bya zhing*/ gang su dag lha dang*/ lha min dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ rjed byed dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ grib gnon dang*/ rgan po dang*/ rgan mo dang*/ g.yog dang*/ 'khor dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ rig sngags 'chang grub pa khyod rnams dengs shig /sa'i phyogs 'dir bdag rdo rje slob dpon che ge mo zhes bya bas sems can thams cad kyis bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ rdo rje slob ma rnams mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rdzogs par bya ba'i don du 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bri bar bya'o// de'i phyir rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bka' thos nas myur du dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de'i mgo bo bdag nyid khro bo chen po'i rdo rje 'bar ba gsor zhing rab tu gsor ba'i ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po 'dis rnam pa brgyar 'gas par bgyid do// zhes dang*/ las gshin gyi sngags dang suṃ bha na'i sngags brjod/

gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brab/ rol bo'i sgra bsgrag go// de nas/ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo dpag tu med pa spros bgegs rnams bsal zhing dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi de nyid dbang chen gyi steng gi bar du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs par gyur par bsam mo// de nas sa gzhi dris byugs la me tog gis mchod nas lag pas reg cing gtso bo'i sngags dang yig brgya lan bdun bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs pa brtan par bya'o// lnga pa slar bgegs mi 'jug cing bsrung ba na/ི seng ldeng ngam lcags rus gang rung gi phur bu tsan+dan dmar po dang yungs kar gyi chus byugs/ tshon skud lngas dkris par me tog gi phreng ba dmar po btags pa bcu 'am/ bzhi'am/ gcig kyang rung khro bo bcu'i rang bzhin la/ rnam pa las gshin sku mdog nag po g.yas be con g.yon sdigs mdzub sku smad rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa can dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa'o// mchan/ du bskyed de/ sngags brgya'am nyer gcig bzlas la/ phur bu bcu yod na phyogs bcu dang*/ bzhi yin na phyogs bzhi/ gcig las med na byang shar du hūm̐ las byung ba'i khron pa gru gsum pa'i nang du bgegs rnams bcug la/ rang gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i phyag g.yon dang po'i phur bu las gshin stod khro bo dang smad rdo rje rtse gcig par gyur pa'i bgegs kyi spyi bo nas btab/ g.yas dang pos rdo rje'i tho ba thogs nas/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ phaṭa phaṭa kī li kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bigh+nāṃ kā ya wāka tsit+ta kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces phur bus btab/ tho bas brdung zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra mut+ga ra ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐/ zhes tho bas brdungs pas spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phug pas bgegs thams cad bde ba chen po'i ngang du brgyal bar bsam/

bgegs lhag ma rnams kyang rgyang ring du bros par bsam mo// drug pa gnas gang du sa chog 'di rnams dgos mi dgos bshad pa ni/ ji skad du/ khang bzang brag stong ba lang lhas// gtsug lag khang sogs chu 'gram la// sngon dus byas pa'i gnas dag tu// ma brkos na yang dag sa yin// zhes gsungs pas/ de rnams su brkos nas sbyang ba ni mi dgos la/ sngags chu thal ba de kho nas sbyang ba sogs dgos shing gzhan brtag bslang nas bzung bsrung ba rnams kyang dgos so// gnyis pa sta gon la bzhi/ sa sta gon/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ slob ma sta gon rnams so// dang po sa sta gon ni/ stegs bu'i dbus su dris sbags pa'i tshom bu gcig bkod/ mthar mchod pas bskor| mdun du dkar gtor gcig bshams/ skabs 'dir bdag lha'i nga rgyal tsam ma gtogs bdag bskyed rgyas pa mi dgos so// de nas/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal dbus kyi tshom bu baṃ las byung ba'i sa yi lha mo zhes pa nas/ sa'i lha mo ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo thon pa mdun gyi dam tshig pa la thim/ oṃ pṛ thi wī sogs nas/ rdor dril 'dzin pa'i bar sngar sa chog gi skabs ltar la/ oṃ tshur spyon sogs kyi tshab tu/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang*// sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// ji ltar bdud kyi dpung bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi dpung*// bcom nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ sa yi lha mos de ltar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin nas sa gzhi de nyid du thim par gyur par bsam/ rdo rje bcings pa nang du rdo rje nang bsdams byas pas sa de mnan la/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ rdo rje bsdams pa las byung ba'i yi ge hūm̐ 'bar ba 'phros pas dbang chen gyi 'og gi bar rdo rjer byas par gyur zhes dang*/

oṃ badz+ra dṛ ḍho tiṣ+ṭha/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs nas sa de rang gi dbang du bya'o// gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ gzhi der dri bzang dang bdud rtsi la yi ge gsum gyis sngags pa byugs shing*| me tog gi gcal bkram pa'i dbus su dri bzang bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar bas gtso bo'i gnas su gru bzhi/ phyogs bzhir 'khor gyi gnas su zlum po re re/ phyir 'khor yug dang bcas pa bris la/ mthar spyi mchod chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo/ sman raka gtor ma rnams tshar gcig /sgos mchod spos/ mar me/ lha bshos rnams lha grangs dang mnyam pa dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon du phyogs mtshams kyi bsham tshul bshad pa ltar bkod legs par bsham/ skabs 'dir dbang rdzas gzhan rnams bsham mi dgos/ bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang ma rig rgyu sogs byas rjes mchod pa sman raka gtor ma byin rlabs dang tshogs zhing sogs dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon ltar byas nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par bya ba nas| mthu rtsal dang ldan par gyur gyi bar ngag 'don dkyus ltar la/ rang nyid dang rang ces pa dor nas mdun bskyed bsgom/ de nas pus mo g.yas pa sa la btsugs/ lag g.yas spos dang g.yon dril bu thogs nas/ lce hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur par bsam/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// rig pa'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// dkyil 'khor bri bar bdag 'tshal lo// de phyir khyod la bdag gus la// bka' drin gnang bar mdzad par rigs// 'gro ba 'khor ba'i don mdzad pa'i// sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol// 'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha// lha gzhan 'jig rten skyong ba dang*| |'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang*// sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba// gang su rdo rje'i spyan snga rnams// bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol// bdag ni che ge rdo rje can| |'jam dpal gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor ni// yo byad ci 'byor ba dag gis// 'gro ba sbyang phyir bdag bri na// de phyir bdag dang slob ma la// rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas// dkyil 'khor par bcas thams cad la// nye bar spyod par mdzad pa rigs// zhes don bsam pas lan gsum brjod pas khyod kyis gzhan don rgya chen po gyis shig ces gnang ba bstsal bar bsam/

mchod pa dang bcas pas bzhugs su gsol lo// gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ gser dngul zangs rdo shel las byas pa'am/ med na thod pas kyang rung la/ zhi rgyas dang las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i lto ba'i zlum la sor bcu drug /lto ba'i 'og nas kha'i bar gyi dpangs su sor nyi shu/ kha'i mtshams nas thur du 'phyang ba'i mchur sor gnyis/ mgrin par sor drug /mchu'i mtha' nas mtha'i bar gyi kha zheng sor brgyad/ mgul pa'i sbub sum cha dang bcas par sor lnga/ mchu gnyis kyi zheng sum cha dang bcas pa'i sor re re ba dag go// dbang drag gi bum pa ni de ltar ma yin no// zhes tshad ldan gyi rgyud rnams nas gsungs so// bum pa rtsa ba ma 'byar zhing nag po dang chag gas med pa rab lha grangs dang mnyam pa/ bum pa'i rgyu dang grangs ni/ zla gsang rtsa rgyud kyi le'u drug pa dbang gi le'ur/ gser dngul zangs lcags mtsho mo sding*// rin po che yi bum pa la// sna tshogs gos kyis yang dag dkris// me tog 'bras bu rnams kyis brgyan// bdud rtsi lngas bkang byang chub sems// sman lnga dri lnga rin chen lnga| |'bru lnga ldan pa'i bum pa ni// lha yi grangs dang mnyam pa dgos// byin gyis brlabs la dbang bskur ro// zhes gsungs so// tha ma yang rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis med du mi rung la de gnyis legs par bkru/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug /mgul chings nag pos dkri/ hūm̐ bdun bzlas pa'i srad bu dkar pos lan bdun/ oṃ badz+ra shi kha ra ru tra ma ṭa di shaṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing 'ching*/ rnam rgyal la bum mtshan chos 'byung gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la gur gum sogs dri bzang pos lha'i sa bon hūm̐ g.yon la bh+yoḥ mdun g.yas rgyab rnams su ya re re bri bar bya ba bshad pa ltar byas kyang rung*/ las bum la'ang sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma la sa bon ya bris kyang rung*/

las bum la chos 'byung mi 'bri ba yin no// rta glang bong bu sogs kyis ma bgrod pa'i chu gtsang srog chags med pas bum pa gnyis kyi sum gnyis bkang*/ chang dang 'o ma cung zad kyang blug /bum rdzas thun mong ba lnga tshan lnga ni/ gro/ nas/ 'bras/ sran/ so ba/ til te 'bru lnga zer yang drug /gser/ dngul/ byu ru/ mu tig /mu men te rin po che lnga/ sle tres/ kan+ḍa ka ri/ shu dag dkar po/ dbang lag /rgya mtsho'i lbu ba ste sman lnga/ chu'i snying po lan tshwa/ bcud kyi snying po 'o ma/ rtsi thog gi snying po mar/ shing gi snying po bu ram/ me tog gi snying po sbrang rtsi ste snying po lnga/ tsan+dan dkar dmar/ gur gu+um/ dzā ti/ ga pur te dri lnga/ de dag gi steng du thun mong ma yin pa'i sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga bsnan pas bum rdzas so lnga po gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas bum par gzhug go// mchan/ med mi rung ba yin pas blugs/ 'bras bu can gyi shing los kha brgyan/ rnam rgyal gyi steng du dung chur gong ltar chu dang rdzas sbyar ba blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tod ka ṭhaḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐| lan bdun bzlas la bzhag /de steng rdo rje la me tog gi srad bu btags pa bzhag /bum pa gnyis ku sha'i gdan dang bcas pa rnam rgyal gtso bo'i lha gnas kyi mdun las cung zad g.yas dang*/ las thams cad pa g.yon zur te gnyis ka'i mthar 'khor gyi tshom bu phyi'i mchod pa'i nang du bshams la/ lha sta gon gyi bum pa lnga yod na rnam rgyal dang las bum ni gzhung ltar dang yum sras sprul pa gnyis dang bzhi po rang rang gi lha mtshan gyi phyir dgod do// mchan/ bum pa bskyed bzlas ni/ bsangs sbyangs nas bzung*/ zlog par mdzod cig gi bar dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon ltar bya'o// bzhi pa slob ma sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ bum pa dang*/ mchod gtor rnams yol bas bsgribs te slob dpon gyi nye logs su sta gon gyi yo byad rnams 'du byas la/

slob ma snod dang ldan nges shing dge bsnyen la sogs pa'i sdom pa 'og ma gnyis dang ldan pa rgyud sbyangs shing gus pas bsten pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sdom pa don du gnyer zhing rdo rje theg pa las ston pa gzhan mi 'tshol ba sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams gos gsar pa gyon/ khrus byas/ mdun du gus pas maṇ+ḍal phul/ pus btsugs thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du me tog bzung nas gus pas 'dug pa la/ sdom ni/ kun slong bcos shing nang dbang bskur// gsol ba gdab cing mdun du gzhug /thun mong sdom gzung byin rlabs mchod// so shing 'khyor chu ku sha dang*// srung skud sbyin dang spro ba bskyed// srung dang rmi lam brtag pa'o// zhes pa ltar chos bcu bzhi las/ dang po kun slong bcos pa ni// slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ 'jig rten 'di nyid kyi mngon par mtho ba don du gnyer ba ma yin/ 'jig rten pha rol du mngon par mtho ba'i ched du'ang ma yin gyi/ 'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsum gyi phun sum tshogs pa 'thob par bya ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor du 'jug par bya'o// de lta bas ni mngon par mtho ba gzhan gnyis kyang rang bzhin gyis 'bad mi dgos par 'byung ba yin no// zhes bsgrags/ gnyis pa nang dbang bskur ba ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pa slob ma la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'od du zhu ba bkug pa slob dpon gyi kha nang du bcug pa sku yi dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar bab pas gshin rje'i gshed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gnas pa la/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs yum dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs rjes chags kyi mes zhu ba'i byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur te de nyid pad+ma nas phyung ste dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor 'khod par gyur par dpon slob gnyis kas bsam/

gsum pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob mas/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// zhes pa nas/ mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes pa'i bar lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bzhi pa 'dzin du gzhug pa ni/ slob ma gcig gtso bor byas te/ des sgo nas thams cad la 'di skad ces smra bar bya ste/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da lta byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes// gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med 'dis// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa// dpung chen dag kyang 'di yis bcom// 'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de nas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod cing yang dag par 'dzin du gzhug go// lnga pa thun mong gi sdom pa 'dzin du bcug pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar lan gsum brjod du gzhug go// drug pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ thog mar las bum gyi chu gtor zhing las gshin gyi sngags lan bdun brjod pas bsrung ba la/ slob ma gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i snying gar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje sngon po rdo rje dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i lte bar āḥlas gsung rdo rje dmar po pad+ma dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar oṃ las sku rdo rje dkar po 'khor lo dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa ste/

thugs phyag mtshan/ gsung yig 'bru/ sku phyag rgya dang bcas pa skad cig gi gsal bar gyur par mos la/ slob dpon gyi lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i srin lag gis gnas de dag tu mas yar dri'i thig le bya zhing*/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// bdun pa mchod pa ni/ de ltar slob ma'i sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur ma thag de la spyi bor me tog /mdun du spos dang mar me/ snying gar dri chab/ zhal lam phyag tu lha bshos rnams las gshin gyi sngags mthar rang rang gi mchod sngags btags pas gnas de rnams su dbul zhing mthar/ dus 'di nas bzung ste 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par mchod pa dang ldan par gyis shig /ces brjod/ brgyad pa dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i phyir du so shing dor ba ni/ 'o ma can gyi shing ngam lcang ma sogs las byas pa'i sor bcu gnyis pa yo ba gas chag 'bus zos rma med pa drang zhing phra sbom ran pa/ mgo mjug ma log pa rtse mor me tog bcings shing*/ gu gul gyis bdug pa/ dri bzang byugs pa/ slob ma thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du las gshin gyi sngags bdun bzlas pa gtad la/ mdun du khru gang gru bzhi pa'i rnam lnga dang dri bzang gis byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du tshom bu lnga'am dgu bkod la/ slob ma byang du kha phyogs pas so shing gi rtse mo bcas te/ mig steng gi nam mkhar lta bas ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra hā sa ha/ zhes ltos pa med par dor ro// de dag gi rtse mo me tog dang bcas pa rang la bltas na mchog gi dngos grub ste rab/ steng du bltas na rig 'dzin dang 'og tu bltas na sa 'og gi dngos grub te 'bring*/ shar du zhi ba/ lhor rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du drag po/ mtshams bzhir 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub ste tha ma'o// dri'i maṇ+ḍal gyi phyi rol tu lhung na dngos grub med do zhes lung ston/ dgu pa ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir 'khyor chu sbyin pa ni/

thog mar baṃ las skyes pa'i chu gtsang baṃ bzlas pas kha bkrus la pho nas dri'i chu la las gshin gyi sngags lan bdun bdun bzlas pa/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsā s+ya sho dhā ya sarba bi kalpa na a pa na ya swā hā/ zhes 'khyor ba g.yon par lan gsum byin la btung zhing lhag ma rgyab du dor ro// bcu pa rmi lam brtag pa'i phyir ku sha sbyin pa ni/ ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa hūm̐ dang dhīḥlas skyes pa las gshin gyi sngags lan bdun bzlas nas/ mang ba stan dang nyung ba sngas kyi ched du thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du/ oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa baṃ/ zhes sbyin/ bcu gcig pa srung skud ni/ slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa'i srad bu dmar po sum ltab byas nas bsgril bar hūm̐ zhes rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum mam drug byas pa skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang bud med kyi g.yas su gnyis skor du/ oṃ bud+dha mai tri rak+ṣa sarbāṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing 'ching*/ de'i mdud pa'i steng du las bum gyi chu dang rdo rjes reg cing las gshin gyi sngags brjod pas yang dag par bsrung ngo*// bcu gnyis pa chos zab mo la spro ba bskyed pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams// u duṃ wā ra'i me tog bzhin// rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni shin tu dkon// gang gis mnyam med sems can don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus| |bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sdig pa gang zhig sngon byas pa// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag thams cad zad 'gyur na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas rnams smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// yang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros brtan cing mi g.yo na// sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi// ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa'i// bdag nyid chen po kun gyi ni// bstan pa 'di la khyod rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa// de phyir khyod rnams theg chen la// sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dong bas na// rang byung skal pa chen po pa// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes pa'i don yang bkrol te bshad nas spro ba bskyed do// bcu gsum pa bsrung ba ni/

slob ma la las bum gyi chus 'thor zhing las gshin gyi sngags lan gsum brjod pas bsrung zhing bzlas pa'i don du sngags de nyid slob ma rnams la byin la/ des kyang nyal khar brgya phrag sogs bzla'o// bcu gcig pa rmi lam brtag pa ni/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ bu kye sang ni dkyil 'khor dag /mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol zhig dang*// rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa// de kun drang por nga la smros// khyod rnams ci bde bar sngar gtad pa'i ku sha chung ba rtse g.yas su bstan pa sngas dang*/ che ba rtse sngas su bstan pa gdan du chug la phan tshun gcig la gcig ma reg glo g.yas pa sa la phab pa seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis mgo byang ngam dkyil 'khor la bstan la/ bsam pa'ang lha dang bla ma la gus pas rdo rje theg pa don du gnyer ba'i bsam pa las gzhan pa'i nyon mongs kyi sems ma bskyed par nyol zhig /rmi lam bzang na lung bstan dang*/ ngan na bsrung thabs kyang byar yod pas rmi lam bzang ngan gang rmis pa sang drang por nga la smros shig /ces bsgos la so so'i gnas su gtang ngo*// slob ma rnams kyis kyang phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas ji ltar bde ba'i gnas su phyin nas sngar gang bsgo ba ltar byas la nyal zhing rmi lam brtag par bya'o// slob dpon yang dkyil 'khor gyi khang par sngags bzla zhing nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis nyal nas nangs par gtor ma btang nas sta gon gyi tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu byas la bum pa gnyis dben par mchod pa dang bcas bzhugs su gsol/ gzhan dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad rnams bsdus nas rang nyid dkyil 'khor khang pa nas thon la slob ma rnams la rmi lam dri'o// de yang ji skad du/ dang po thun gyi rmi lam gang*// bad kan las byung shes par bya// gnyis pa gang byung mkhris pa ste// 'jig rten la yod smad pa yin// gsum pa rlung byung shes par bya// bzhi pa bden par byung ba yin// zhes gsungs pas/

rmi lam ni tho rangs kyi thun tha mar gang byung de nyid tshad mar bzung ngo*// de la yang*/ dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma dang*// mdza' bshes sogs dang 'phrad pa dang*// ri dang mchod rten la 'dzegs dang*// nyi ma shar ba chu brgal ba// sogs bzang*/ de las ldog pa ngan pa yin no// rmi lam bzang na de yang rab 'bring tha gsum la ltos nas sngags kyi dngos grub mchog dman 'bring gsum gang 'grub lung bstan la/ ngan na ni bzlog pa'i thabs 'khyil pa dang las gshin gyi sngags bzla ba dang*/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang*/ bdag med pa'i don bsgom pa dang*/ gtor ma drug cu pa la sogs pa/ mchan/ gtong ba dang*/ tshogs 'khor bya ba dang*/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang*/ lha dang bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa sogs kyis bzlog /yang na skyabs sems byas la/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i gdan la laṃ yig gi 'od kyis sgrib pa sbyangs nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis sangs rgyas spyan ma sku mdog dkar po pad zlar bzhugs pa dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing*/ g.yas 'khor lo'i lte bar mig 'bras kyis mtshan pa dang*/ g.yon pad+ma'i lte bar mig 'bras kyis mtshan pa 'dzin pa'i snying gar zla ba kha sbyor gyi bar du rang gi ming yig yod pa zla ba gnyis kyi phyi bzla bya'i sngags kyis rgya gram du dkris par bsams nas/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swā hā/ zhes ci 'grub bzlas la 'jog khar/ spyan ni 'khor lo mdzes ma ste// 'chi ba slong bar byed pa'i mchog /bdag cag sdug bsngal nyen pa la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes bstod cing gsol nas rlung bum can ci rigs pa bsgom/ 'dis ni dus min 'chi ba bslu zhing rmi lam ngan pa bzlog pa'i mchog yin pas/ sta gon gyi skabs ma yin pa'i dus gzhan du'ang rmi lam ngan pa byung na 'di byas na shin tu phan che'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum|

dkyil 'khor bri zhing rgyan dgram pa/ dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod bstod bzlas pa bya ba/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ yang zlog gi dkyil 'khor 'di rgyud sde spyi'i dkyil 'khor phal dang mi gcig par bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i gur khang bcu gsum mchod rten dang bcas pa/ mchan/ dbus su lha gnas 'bri dgos pas phal cher ras bris sogs ma gtogs rdul mtshon byed pa nyung bas 'dir ras bris kyi dbang du byas la/ gal te spros pa la dga' bas rdul mtshon byed na ni thig dang 'bri lugs slob dpon gyi zhal rgyun man ngag ltar bya zhing*/ ye thig dang tshon gyi cho ga sogs bla med kyi dkyil chog gzhan ltar la skabs thob 'don pa spros pas grub bo// ras bris sogs byed na sngar gyi stegs bu'i dbus su ras bris bkram la/ dbang rdzas dang mchod pa sman raka gtor ma sogs bsham tshul dbang chog ltar dang*/ de dag bkod legs par grub nas/ gnyis pa sgrub cing mchod pa la bdag mdun bum pa sgrub cing mchod bstod bzlas pa bya ba dang*/ gsum pa bdag nyid 'jug cing slob ma la dbang bskur ba sogs ni dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon kho na dkyus ji lta bar nyams su blang bas yang dag par 'grub pa nyid do// gsum pa rjes la gnyis/ gshegs bsdu bya ba dang*/ lag len gyi gnad 'ga' zhig rjes su gdams pa'o// dang po ni/ slob ma rjes 'dzin rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i lugs zla gsang rtsa rgyud kyi dbang gi le'ur/ dbang bskur gnang ba ma thob bar// gang zhig sngags la 'jug byed cing*// nyan zhing sgrub par byed pa rnams// 'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur// dbang ma thob pa'i gang zag ni// gzhan gyi yon tan gang mang yang*// 'khor lo srog shing med pa bzhin// de bas dbang rnams rim par nos// 'jam dpal nga yi bka' la nyon// zhes gsungs so// mchan/ gang byed kyang grub rjes tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*/

lha tshim pa'i slad du rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dang*/ dge 'dun la chos ston dang*/ byis pa la 'o thug gi ston mo dang*/ glu dang gar la sogs pas yang dag par mchod nas/ rjes chog mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu grub rjes las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya zhing*/ sngar phur bu btab pa rnams/ oṃ badz+ra kī la ya udakīl ya/ sarba kī lān badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa hoḥ zhes pa hūm̐ bzhi pa'i sngags 'don cing rkang pa g.yon brkyang ba dang bskum pa'i phyag rgyas phur bu bton la| oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swā hā/ zhes 'o ma la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas bkrus te phur bu'i lha rnams kyang gshegs su gsol zhing sa la btab nas phur khung yang dgang ngo*// dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad rnams slob dpon nam dkon mchog gsum gyi phyogs su btang*/ khyi dang bya rog la cung zad tsam yang sbyin par ma gsungs la/ gzhan slob ma dang khyim pa sogs kyis kyang longs spyod par ma gsungs so// gnyis pa lag len gyi gnad 'ga' zhig rjes su gdams pa ni/ sngar las ma byas pa'i gnas rnams su ni slob ma rjes 'dzin byed na sngar bshad ma thag pa'i sa chog rnams dang sta gon rgyas par byas la/ yang sngar las ma byas pa'i sa'i gnas su rang gis bsnyen sgrub dang bdag 'jug gi dkyil 'khor byed na'ang slob ma sta gon ma gtogs gzhan thams cad tshang bar bya'o// yang gtsug lag khang dang*/ rgyal po'i pho brang*/ ba lang gi lhas sogs dul zin pa rnams su dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba byed na sa brtag bslang sbyang ba rnams mi dgos shing*/ sa bzung ba dang bsrung ba sa sta gon rnams nges par dgos so// yang zhal ba'i steng dang brag steng du dkyil 'khor bri na las dang bya bas sbyang ba mi dgos so// de'ang cho ga rgyas pa byed na nub dang po sa chog rnams/ nub gnyis pa la sta gon gyi rim pa rnams/

nub gsum pa la dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas rang ngam slob ma gzhug par bya'o// bsdus pa la ni nub gcig gam gnyis la'ang sa chog sta gon dngos gzhi thams cad rdzogs par sgrub du mi rung ba ma yin no// yang slob ma 'jug pa min yang rang nyid sgrub mchod sogs byed na'ang gong gi rig pas sa chog rgyas par dgos mi dgos brtags nas slob ma sta gon ma gtogs gzhan rnams skabs su bya'o// yang rang nyid dam tshig gso ba sogs bdag 'jug zhag sbrel du byed na sa chog rnams dang*/ lha bum sta gon rnams byas rjes dkyil 'khor 'bri zhing rdzas rgyan bkod/ mtshams bcad nas zhag gsum lnga bdun gang rung bdag mdun bum pa yang dag par bsgrubs nas grub pa'i mtshan ma mthong na tho rangs nyi shar bar du bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ nyi shar nas nyin gung gi bar du mdun bskyed dang bum bskyed byas nas bum pa ma bzhu bar bum mdun thun mong du bsnyen pa la 'bad cing*/ thun mthar las bum la las gshin gyi bsnyen pa stong phrag tsam byas rjes bum pa bzhu nas/ nyin gung nyi nub kyi bar du/ bdag 'jug dbang chog ltar rgyas par blang*/ nyi nub nas srod thun bar du tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bsnyen pa ci 'grub bya/ yang gong du bshad pa'i gtsug lag khang sogs sbyangs zin pa rnams su'ang*/ las dang bya bas sbyang ba ma gtogs pa'i gzhan sa chog rnams byas kyang phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyur 'gyur pa ma gtogs lhag pa'i nyes pa ni med pa nyid do// yang las bzhi'i sbyin sreg byed na rang ngam gzhan gyi gnas sam/ dgon pa/ grong gi shar du zhi ba/ byang du rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang*/ lhor drag po'i las sgrub dgos pas phyogs de dag tu sa brtags te/ gang du 'os par bslang ba nas bzung lha sta gon gyi bar byas rjes sbyin sreg gi las la 'jug pa ni cho ga rgyas pa/ sa brtag pa nas bzung sa sta gon gyi bar byas pa cho ga 'bring*/

sa chog sa brtag pa nas bsrung ba'i bar/ mchan/ rnams byas rjes kho nar sbyin sreg la 'jug pa cho ga bsdus pa'i lugs so// yang rab gnas la'ang*/ nub dang por sa chog rnams/ nub gnyis par sa/ lha/ bum pa sta gon rnams byas rjes rab gnas kyi sta gon bya/ nub gsum par rab gnas dngos gzhi byed pa cho ga rgyas pa'i lugs/ nub dang por sa bzung ba dang bsrungs ba byas rjes sa/ lha/ bum pa rab gnas kyi sta gon bya/ nub gnyis par dngos gzhi byed pa cho ga 'bring*/ dngos gzhi bdag mdun bum pa dkyil chog ltar bsgrubs rjes/ nub dang por rab gnas kyi sta gon dang*/ nub gnyis par rab gnas dngos gzhi byed pa cho ga bsdus pa'i lugs/ rab gnas dngos gzhi nyi ma gcig tu byed pa cho ga shin tu bsdus pa'o// yang rab gnas dang slob ma rjes 'dzin lhan cig tu byed na nub dang por sa chog /nub gnyis par lha bum pa rab gnas| slob ma rnams kyi sta gon rnams rim pa bzhin du byas rjes/ nub gsum par rab gnas dngos gzhi'i cho ga grub nas slob ma la dbang bskur dkyil chog dkyus ltar byas pas grub la/ 'di la bdag 'jug ni bum bskyed kyi rjes de nyid du blang ngo*// yang gtsug lag khang dang*/ rgyal po'i pho brang dang*/ skyed mos tshal dang*/ mchod rten la sogs pa dag sngar ma sbyang ba'i sar byed na sa brtag pa nas bsrung ba'i bar ni med mi rung yin la/ khyad par ni stegs bu 'chos mi dgos pa kho na yin zhing*/ de dag la sa sta gon dang lha sta gon gnyis grub na shin tu legs shing*/ ma grub na chad pa'i skyon du ni mi 'gyur ro// de dag gi tshe 'dod don gsol ba rnams kyi skabs/ dkyil 'khor zhes pa'i mal rnams su skabs don gang yin gyi 'don pa bsgyur ba kho nas grub bo// yang sāts+tsha sogs byed pa'i skabs su'ang sa brtag bslang sbyang gzung bsrung ba rnams byas na/ sa de dag gis sāts+tsha'i rgyu byas na nyes par mi 'byung zhing phan yon dang ldan par 'gyur ro// mdor na sa'i las bya ba thams cad la sa chog grub na bar gcod dang nyes pa med cing las gang yin pa de nyid mthar phyin zhing bkra shis pa'i dgos pa khyad par can dang ldan pa yin no//
